taskVersion.name: pilot-ves-label-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Opiro, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model from the published survey:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 54.639 | 0.2147 | 0.2147
2 | 9147.8 | 0.30305 | 0.51774
3 | 1119.9 | 21.107 | 21.625
4 | 2566.8 | - | -

The paper labels this station's curve as KH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Opiro, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the paper's curve-type label does not fit the layer values.

**Station Opiro Site Note**

**Location:** Etche LGA
**Subsurface Profile:** The interpreted model for Station Opiro consists of four resistivity layers. The sequence begins with a thin, low-resistivity layer (54.64 $\Omega\text{m}$), followed by a very high-resistivity layer (9147.8 $\Omega\text{m}$). The third layer shows a decrease in resistivity (1119.9 $\Omega\text{m}$), while the fourth layer shows an increase (2566.8 $\Omega\text{m}$).

**Curve Classification:** Applying the curve-type notation to the resistivity values ($r_1 < r_2 > r_3$ and $r_2 > r_3 < r_4$), the sequence produces the letters K and H, respectively. Therefore, the VES curve is a KH-type. This is consistent with the label provided in the published survey.

{"curve_type_stated": "KH", "label_issue_flagged": false}
